review.verbatim_critique:
[D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=subfield below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The note proves the full-class upper bound \(C\min\{1,dK\log(eK)/n\}\) and the lower bound \(c\min\{1,dK\log(1+\sqrt{K/d})/n\}\), which match only in the region \(K\ge d^2\); the exact frontier for \(2<K<d^2\), the advertised attaining estimator, and the consistency boundary remain open. The TL;DR, project-justification “Fill,” and setup nevertheless describe an explicit all-regime rate, evaluated certificate, and matching estimator-converse pair as the headline kernel, although these objects are only definitions and open-ended questions. The parametric-MSE criterion is narrower than the missing consistency theorem, and its unbounded-\(d\) necessity relies on an internally named accepted binary theorem without public theorem text or a bibliographic citation, so that load-bearing source requires verification. The solved many-arm region and exact mixture and factorial identities constitute a genuine subfield contribution, but the missing central transition, absence of an instantiated certificate, and stale headline claims prevent a field-tier paper and constrain the projected score.

DIRECTED IMPROVEMENT (re-derive the SAME object implementing this, do not reproduce the prior note): Construct finite coefficient tables whose approximation bias and exact factorial-lift variance attain the same evaluated scale as normalized moment-prior separation, then prove the resulting matching risk formula throughout \(2<K<d^2\). Use that formula to derive the necessary-and-sufficient consistency condition.
